name: Server Console
summary: A dashboard for your Automaton server with charts: CPU, memory and disk over 24 hours, current values, certificates, backups and OS update badges. Installs with nothing to fill in.
description: Shows how your Automaton server and its Runners are doing, read-only: CPU, memory and disk as 24 hour charts, current values, load, Docker disk use, OS name and uptime, pending and security updates and restart-needed badges, server and Runner versions, certificate expiry and the last backup. Nothing to fill in when you install it: it finds your server's API address by itself. Alerts to a Slack, Discord or Telegram webhook can be turned on later in the app. It only asks for server:read, so it cannot change anything on the server.

application.description: A dashboard for your Automaton server with charts: CPU, memory and disk over 24 hours, current values, certificates, backups and OS update badges. Installs with nothing to fill in.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py console.py && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp main.py console.py index.html dashboard.js console.css dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js dist/ui/

settings.name: API_BASE_URL
settings.description: Only if the console cannot find your server's API by itself: its base URL, for example https://api.example.com

settings.name: DISK_FREE_WARN_PERCENT
settings.description: Warn when less than this percent of the disk is free

settings.name: SECURITY_UPDATE_DAYS
settings.description: Warn when security updates have been waiting longer than this many days

settings.name: REBOOT_DAYS
settings.description: Warn when a restart has been required longer than this many days
